def copyscore(M):
    out=ETn@M.T  # 3000x640
    lg=(out*torch.tensor(fn))@ET.T  # 3000x3000
    diag=lg.diag()
    z=(diag-lg.mean(1))/lg.std(1)
    rank=(lg>diag[:,None]).sum(1)
    return z.mean().item(), (rank<10).float().mean().item()
